description: This file defines a C# interface for an Orleans grain, specifically for a streaming history grain. It includes method signatures for becoming a consumer of a stream, stopping consumption, and retrieving received items, indicating its role in stream processing and grain interactions.

classes.name: IStreamingHistoryGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain interface for streaming history management, extending IGrainWithStringKey with methods to manage stream consumption and data retrieval.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Starts the grain as a consumer of a specified stream, with optional filter data.

methods.name: StopBeingConsumer
methods.description: Stops the grain's consumption of streams.

methods.name: GetReceivedItems
methods.description: Retrieves a list of received item identifiers or data.
